Crossbows with integrated decocking features let you safely release tension at the end of a hunt without firing an arrow or carrying a separate discharge target. This is primarily achieved via built-in crank mechanisms that offer controlled backwinding.
TenPoint +1
Top Crossbows with Decocking Systems

* TenPoint Titan X De-Cock: Known for its reliability, this model features the ACUdraw De-Cock system with an internal braking mechanism. It allows silent cocking and safe, one-finger decocking without holding down buttons.
YouTube·Lancaster Archery Supply +1

* Wicked Ridge Invader M1 / Raider 400: Wicked Ridge (TenPoint’s sister company) offers the ACUdraw De-Cock on their affordable models. You can discharge the bow by engaging the decock button and safely backwinding the crank handle.
YouTube·Lancaster Archery Supply +1

* Ravin Crossbows: Ravin integrates the Versa-Draw cocking/decocking system across almost their entire lineup. You use a thumb-activated release to transfer tension directly to the cocking handle, requiring you to maintain a firm grip as you lower the string.
Borkholder Archery +1

* Excalibur RevX: Featured as a top contender by Field & Stream, this recurve-style crossbow uses their safe un-cocking system, which avoids complex gears by allowing you to manually hook and unhook the string.
Field & Stream

How They WorkDecocking mechanisms vary slightly by manufacturer, but most systems allow you to engage a decocking mode by pressing a button or flipping a lever. You can then slowly and safely reverse the crank to uncock the bow.Many systems include an internal brake or anti-dry-fire safety that halts the crank automatically if you accidentally let go, greatly reducing the risk of injury.
TenPoint +1

Crossbow archery is an ancient yet technologically advanced method of shooting that uses a horizontal bow mounted on a firearm-style stock. It allows archers to pre-cock the weapon and lock the string in place, giving them unlimited time to aim with firearm-like scopes.
Reddit +3
Key Advantages

* Accessibility: Because the weapon is pre-cocked, it eliminates the need to manually draw a heavy bowstring while aiming, making it highly accessible for beginners or hunters with physical limitations.
* Stability: The horizontal design allows you to use shooting rests for increased steadiness.
* Precision: Crossbows accommodate advanced optical scopes and consistently deliver flat trajectories at longer distances (40 to 60+ meters for 175-pound draw weights).
Pyramyd AIR +1

Popular Equipment & Brands
Modern crossbows are generally broken down into Recurve (traditional, simpler string changes) and Compound (pulley systems for increased speed and compact width). Top brands include:
Hunter Ed

* TenPoint: High-end, premium models often integrated with advanced optics (e.g., the TenPoint TRX 515).
* Ravin: Known for ultra-compact, high-speed, and precise designs (e.g., the Ravin R26X).
* Excalibur: Famous for durable, heavy-duty recurve crossbows (e.g., the Excalibur RevX).
Archery Country

Getting StartedBefore purchasing, it is critical to familiarize yourself with your specific state or local regulations, as crossbow hunting and shooting may fall into specialized "any legal weapon" seasons rather than general archery hunts.
TenPoint
To explore inventory, compare prices, or find specialized gear (like bolts, broadheads, and cases), check out the Archery Country Crossbows catalog or review gear options on Pyramyd AIR Crossbows. Always refer to local government wildlife resources to ensure full compliance with regional laws.

Modern crossbows are high-performance, compact, and accurate tools designed for hunting and sport, typically firing bolts at 350–500+ feet per second (FPS). They utilize advanced materials (fiberglass, carbon fiber), compound cams for high energy, and integrated loading systems (cranks, magazines) for speed.
YouTube +4

Top Modern Crossbow Features & Models (2025-2026)

* Speed and Power: Models like the TenPoint Nitro 505 (505 FPS) and Ravin R29X deliver massive kinetic energy for deep penetration.
* Advanced Cocking: Many now feature integrated, silent, and detachable cocking devices (e.g., Excalibur Charger X, Barnett CCD) for effortless cocking.
* Compact Design: Modern limbs are often parallel to the barrel or use reverse-draw technology (e.g., Wicked Ridge RDX 400) for better maneuverability in tight blinds.
* Top 2025/2026 Models:
* Best Overall: TenPoint Venom X
* Best Recurve: Excalibur RevX
* Best Value/Budget: CenterPoint Wrath 430X or Sniper 370
* Fastest: TenPoint Nitro 505
* Most Innovative: Ravin R18
* Repeating Crossbows: Tactical and rapid-fire options, such as the Steambow AR-6 Stinger II, offer quick follow-up shots with speed, using magazines.
YouTube +7

Key Considerations

* Safety: Always engage the safety after cocking; modern bows are incredibly powerful.
* Maintenance: Compound crossbows need regular string care, while recurve options are easier to maintain.
* Accessories: Look for packages including high-quality optics (scopes) to maximize accuracy.
Fin Feather Fur +1

An ethanol testing kit is a simple, reusable tool used by automotive and marine enthusiasts to measure the exact percentage of ethanol alcohol in pump gasoline or E85 fuel. Because ethanol naturally attracts water and can cause severe engine corrosion or lean-running conditions, these kits help verify that your fuel quality matches your engine's tuning requirements.
Fuel-It! +2

How an Ethanol Testing Kit WorksMost physical testing kits rely on the water-separation principle. Because ethanol bonds more strongly with water than with gasoline, adding water forces the ethanol out of the fuel suspension so it can be visually measured. Testing takes only 3 simple steps:
Fuel-It! +2

* Add Water: Fill the bottle or tube up to the designated "Water Fill Line".
* Add Fuel: Top off the container with your fuel sample up to the designated "Gasoline Fill Line"
.

* Shake & Settle: Secure the cap tightly, shake the bottle vigorously, and let it rest on a flat surface for 5 minutes. The liquid will separate into two distinct layers; the height of the bottom water/alcohol layer indicates the exact percentage on the graduated scale.
YouTube·Steve Morris Engines +2

Highly-Rated Kits & Options

* Fuel-It! Glass Ethanol Content Tester - Pro Test Kit: This is a premium option priced at $32.99 on the Fuel-It! Official Store. It features two high-quality, reusable 25ml glass testers with screw-on caps, pipettes, a microfiber towel, and a protective telescopic carrying case. Reviewers on Burger Motorsports rate it highly for its full-scale, laser-etched graphics that do not wear off when exposed to raw gasoline.
Fuel-It! +1

* REV-X E85 Super Tester: A popular, cost-effective full-size bottle available on Walmart and Amazon. It features bold, laminated, smudge-proof increments that range from standard pump fuel ratings (E10, E15) up to full race E90 blends.
* EVP Ultimate E85 Tester: Offered by Evolution Powersports, this heavy-duty bottle is designed specifically with an extra-wide neck. It is engineered to accept a gas pump nozzle directly, completely eliminating the need for separate pouring cups or funnels at the gas station.
* Holley E85 Checker: A compact, pocket-sized tester available via AutoZone that is tailored specifically for performance tuning and carbureted E85 setups.
Key Features to Consider Before Purchasing

* Bottle Material: Glass testers like the Fuel-It! Glass Tester offer the best long-term clarity and resist clouding, while high-density plastics are more durable and won't shatter if dropped in a garage.
Fuel-It! +1

* Neck Diameter: Standard thin-neck tubes require a pipette or dropper to fill. Wide-mouth designs allow you to pump or pour gasoline directly into the container with fewer spills.
* Measurement Scale Range: Ensure the kit fits your application. Standard pump gas kits usually focus on a 0% to 30% range, while specialized "Corn Field" or E85 kits focus heavily on the E60 to E100 spectrum for high-performance vehicles.

The "Ski-Doo REV" refers to the revolutionary snowmobile chassis introduced by BRP (Bombardier Recreational Products) in 2003. It permanently transformed the snowmobile industry by introducing a "rider-forward" design—shifting the seat and steering forward—to center the rider's mass, improve leverage, and reduce fatigue.
Ski-Doo +2
Since its inception, the REV chassis has continuously evolved to enhance the rider experience across various terrains.
YouTube·Ski-Doo
Evolution of the Ski-Doo REVThe original REV broke the mold by forcing snowmobilers to adopt a more active, motorcycle-like riding posture. This massive ergonomic shift allowed riders to stand up and absorb bumps much more easily than older, sit-down models. Over the last two decades, this design has evolved through several groundbreaking generations:
YouTube·SnowTrax TV +1

* The Original REV (2003): Shifted the rider's feet under their body, moving mass 12 inches forward and an inch higher.
* The REV-X (2008): Advanced the rider-centered platform, shedding 50 pounds of weight while increasing legroom. It later branched into specialized versions like the REV-XP (for deep snow) and REV-XS (for aggressive trail riding).
* REV Gen5 (Current Generation): The most advanced platform on the snow. Built with purpose-driven bodywork, it is optimized for technical terrain, shedding more weight and featuring a completely redesigned tMotion rear suspension for improved handling and maneuverability.
Ski-Doo +5

Ski-Doo REV Models TodayToday, the REV Gen5 platform dominates across BRP's distinct snowmobile families. Depending on how and where you ride, the REV is configured into these specialized trims:

* Trail & Crossover (e.g., MXZ, Renegade): Designed for aggressive cornering and high-speed trail riding.
* Deep Snow (e.g., Summit, Freeride): Narrower, extremely lightweight, and built for technical tree lines and deep powder.
* Utility & Touring (e.g., Expedition, Skandic): Utilizes robust and sporty variations of the REV chassis (formerly REV-XU) to balance work capacity with superior handling.

Recurve crossbows are highly favored for hunting because their simple, cam-less designs offer supreme reliability, less mechanical noise, and the ability to easily change strings in the field without a bow press.
Outdoor Canada +1
Top Hunting Models by BrandIf you are looking to upgrade or find a reliable model, these are the standout options and typical price points:

* Excalibur (Premium & Mid-Range): Unchallenged as the market leader in recurve technology.
* Micro 360 TD or MAG Air: Great entry-to-mid level models (approx. $550 - $780) that are lightweight and excellent for still-hunting or walking through the brush.
* RevX & Assassin Extreme: Top-tier takedown models (approx. $1,300 - $1,600) equipped with integrated cranks and match-grade triggers.
Crossbow Nation +6

* Barnett (Budget-Friendly): Reliable entry-level models.
* Wildcat CRX or Expeditions: Available through retailers like Walmart Archery, these are perfect for those starting out on a budget.
Walmart

* CenterPoint (Traditional Value):
* Hornet/Patriot Lines: Known for being dependable, lightweight, and offering an old-school feel.
CenterPoint Archery

Key Hunting Specs to Look For

* Draw Weight: To ethically harvest large game like deer or elk, look for a minimum of 45 lbs to 150 lbs of draw weight, depending on your local regulations.
onX Maps

* Speed: Most hunting recurves hit the 300 to 400 fps mark, which is more than enough for deep penetration and ethical kills on target at 20 to 40 yards.
onX Maps

* Maintenance: Always ensure your package includes a rope cocker or integrated crank to make loading safe and manageable.
